info.title: Wonder Egg Priority
info.synopsis: Ai Ohto è una ragazza di 14 anni che durante una passeggiata notturna per le vie della città sente una voce misteriosa, dalla quale riceve in dono un uovo dicendole: “Se desideri cambiare il futuro tutto quello che devi fare è scegliere ora: adesso credi in te stessa e rompi l’uovo”.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: A pair of mysterious voices lead 14-year-old Ai Ohto to a strange egg, promising her a chance at what she wants most. What's inside the egg? And what does Ai really want?

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: A pair of mysterious voices lead 14-year-old Ai Ohto to a strange egg, promising her a chance at what she wants most. What's inside the egg? And what does Ai really want?

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Ai meets Neiru, another girl who is buying Eggs. She's given the cold shoulder at first, but could that change after the next time they crack their Eggs? Assuming they make it back alive, that is.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2
tmdb.synopsis: Ai meets Neiru, another girl who is buying Eggs. She's given the cold shoulder at first, but could that change after the next time they crack their Eggs? Assuming they make it back alive, that is.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: While buying Eggs for herself and Neiru, Ai meets Rika, a former idol who is there for the same reason. Rika quickly pushes her way into Ai's life, but what lies beneath her cheerful and callous exterior?

tmdb.title: Episodio 3
tmdb.synopsis: While buying Eggs for herself and Neiru, Ai meets Rika, a former idol who is there for the same reason. Rika quickly pushes her way into Ai's life, but what lies beneath her cheerful and callous exterior?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: With Rika out of action, Ai is on the run and struggling to protect two girls from the most devious killer she's faced yet. Meanwhile, a fourth child is also fighting to protect the girls in the Eggs.

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: With Rika out of action, Ai is on the run and struggling to protect two girls from the most devious killer she's faced yet. Meanwhile, a fourth child is also fighting to protect the girls in the Eggs.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Ai, Neiru, Rika, and Momoe are quickly becoming close friends as they continue to protect Eggs. But as they grow closer, questions pile up and tensions rise.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: The girls are attacked by a dangerous new type of enemy while trying to protect their Wonder Eggs. Acca and Ura-Acca may have a solution, but Ai is more concerned with the budding relationship between her mother and Mr. Sasaki.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: The girls are attacked by a dangerous new type of enemy while trying to protect their Wonder Eggs. Acca and Ura-Acca may have a solution, but Ai is more concerned with the budding relationship between her mother and Mr. Sasaki.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: It’s Rika's birthday, and the girls get together to celebrate. Rika, however, is focused on her troubled relationship with her mother, and those worries carry over into her next battle. Will she be able to overcome her inner demons in time?

tmdb.title: Episodio 7

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Acca and Ura-Acca would like to sell you a Wonder Egg. While you make up your mind, they'll explain the Eggs and introduce four of their regular customers: Ai, Neiru, Rika, and Momoe.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The girls are surprised when Neiru invites them all to her house, and even more surprised to find out that she lives at her company. Is Neiru ready to be open about her situation, and how will the others take it if she is?

tmdb.title: Episodio 9

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Ai, Rika, and Neiru confront Acca and Ura-Acca, but are distracted by shocking news from Momoe. Later, Momoe confronts her toughest battle yet while Ai makes a difficult decision.

tmdb.title: Episodio 10

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The girls realize that there's more waiting for them at the end of missions than they bargained for. As doubts pile up and tensions rise, Ura-Acca decides to tell Ai his story.
